items.title: Messenger migration applies cleanly
items.precondition: Dev DB available; feature branch with migration present
steps: Run npm run migrate
Confirm conversations, messages, and message_reactions tables exist
Confirm unique constraint on conversation user pair
items.expected: Migrate succeeds with no version collision; schema matches spec.
items.evidence: npm run migrate on kylie/friends-messenger worktree 2026-07-29: Batch 5 run: 1 migrations (20260729140000_friends_messenger).

items.title: Friends can get-or-create and exchange text
items.precondition: Two accepted mutual accounts A and B
steps: As A, POST create/get conversation with B
As A, send a text message
As B, list conversation messages and see A's message
items.expected: Round-trip text works; conversation is unique per pair.
items.evidence: User requested --done after localhost review on http://localhost:5180 (messenger worktree) 2026-07-29.

items.title: Image message via existing uploads

items.title: Unsend shows Unsent a message
items.precondition: A sent a message to B
steps: As A, DELETE/unsend own message
As A and B, fetch thread
items.expected: Message appears as unsent tombstone; body/image not returned; copy implies Unsent a message.

items.title: Reactions set replace and clear

As B, PUT a different emoji
As B, DELETE reaction
Attempt react on an unsent message

items.title: Open-thread polling picks up peer messages

As B, send a message
Wait up to a few poll intervals
